title: Accelerated Missense Mutation Identification in Intrinsically Disordered Proteins using Deep Learning
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习预测无序蛋白错义突变引起的回旋半径变化，虽聚焦单蛋白构象而非直接PPI，但IDP对象与AI+物理模拟结合的方法对本课题的突变影响建模有可迁移启发。
abstract: We use a combination of Brownian dynamics (BD) simulation results and Deep Learning (DL) strategies for rapid identification of large structural changes caused by missense mutations in intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs). We used ∼ 6500 IDP sequences from MobiDB database of length 20 − 300 to obtain gyration radii from BD simulation on a coarse-grained single bead amino acid model (HPS2 model) used by us and others [Seth et al . J. Chem. Phys. 160 , 014902 (2024), Dignon et al . PLOS Comp. Biology, 14, 2018, Tesei et al . PNAS, 118, 2021] to generate the training sets for the DL algorithm. Using the gyration radii ⟨ R g ⟩ of the simulated IDPs as the training set, we develop a multilayer perceptron neural net (NN) architecture that predicts the gyration radii of 33 IDPs previously studied using BD simulation with 97% accuracy from the sequence and the corresponding parameters from the HPS model. We now utilize this NN to predict gyration radii of every permutation of missense mutations in IDPs. Our approach successfully identifies mutation-prone regions that induce significant alterations in the radius of gyration when compared to the wild-type IDP sequence. We further validate the prediction by running BD simulations on the subset of identified mutants. The neural network yields a (10 4 − 10 6 )-fold faster computation in the search space for potentially harmful mutations. Our findings have substantial implications for rapid identification and understanding diseases related to missense mutations in IDPs and for the development of potential therapeutic interventions. The method can be extended to accurate predictions of other mutation effects in disordered proteins.
abstract_zh: 我们结合布朗动力学（Brownian dynamics, BD）模拟结果与深度学习（Deep Learning, DL）策略，用于快速识别 intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) 中错义突变引起的大规模结构变化。我们使用来自 MobiDB 数据库的约 6500 条长度为 20−300 的 IDP 序列，通过粗粒化单珠氨基酸模型（HPS2 模型）进行 BD 模拟获得回旋半径，该模型由我们及其他研究者使用 [Seth et al. J. Chem. Phys. 160, 014902 (2024), Dignon et al. PLOS Comp. Biology, 14, 2018, Tesei et al. PNAS, 118, 2021]，以生成 DL 算法的训练集。利用模拟 IDP 的回旋半径 ⟨R_g⟩ 作为训练集，我们开发了一种多层感知器神经网络（multilayer perceptron neural net, NN）架构，该架构能够从序列及 HPS 模型的相应参数预测先前通过 BD 模拟研究的 33 个 IDP 的回旋半径，准确率达 97%。我们现在利用此 NN 预测 IDP 中所有错义突变排列的回旋半径。我们的方法成功识别出与野生型 IDP 序列相比，诱导回旋半径显著变化的突变易发区域。我们通过对识别出的突变子集运行 BD 模拟进一步验证预测。神经网络在搜索潜在有害突变的计算空间中实现了 (10^4 − 10^6) 倍的加速。我们的发现对于快速识别和理解与 IDP 中错义突变相关的疾病，以及开发潜在治疗干预措施具有重要意义。该方法可扩展至无序蛋白中其他突变效应的准确预测。
